spans.text: What scant legacies we still possess, you left behind for us.
What convictions burned in your hearts when you first sacrificed yourselves?
What did you hope to gain when you decided to surrender control over your destinies?
Tell me, would you all have made the same decision if you saw how we are now?
Perhaps the only one lesson that we, those who remain, have learned from your sacrifices...
...Is that we will never, ever learn anything from them.
...Click.
Ange, the lurking threats are on the move.
Shall we continue surveillance?
Ange? Do you read me?
They're moving much faster than anything Statesec planned for.
And those bureaucrats... they won't ever consider the errors in orders they gave out from behind the desk.
You mean you plan on using this opportunity to take the wind out of their sails?
That's not the reason we came here. Nor are they the ones responsible for the choices we made.
Take 94 and link up with me. Get the team ready for action.
...The transmission ends.
I'm here.
What is this place? Ange, there's no need for us to be here during a surveillance operation.
It might be unnecessary...but that doesn't mean it's meaningless.
What is this place, according to your neural cloud?
It's a memorial to the fallen. There are no clues or information around here.
The world got worse and worse, even after wars upon wars. Their sacrifices were in vain.
This memorial to the fallen of the last war is enough of an answer.
A sacrifice is the final defense of one's beliefs. They died for what they believed in.
And we, the ones who lived, have no right to assign value to the sacrifices of others.
I will not adjust my opinion in light of that.
...And you decided to interfere with Griffin's business with the same attitude?
You knew very well that what you did would only expose us prematurely.
...It's all for the sake of future operations.
But if it all comes to nothing in the end, are you willing to accept the fact that everything you did was in vain?
I will not, nor is there a need to consider such a possibility.
You're becoming more and more of a stranger to me.
"Protect your friends in the AR Team no matter the cost, even if you have to sacrifice yourself."
Weren't you the one who taught me this core principle?
A bouquet of fresh flowers is laid before the memorial.
Things are different from how they used to be.
Nothing's changed. It's just that you've become weak.
Ha, you don't quite seem to know the difference.
However, you'll probably begin to understand after this operation.
Really?
Do you know what's going to happen during this operation?
I don't, M4A1...
But it definitely won't be anything good, right?
...Aren't you the optimist.
The only good thing that can come of this is that we survive.
Do your best to achieve that, then you'll understand...
The meaning of sacrifice, and everything you see before you...
...I assure you of that.
